info.title: PREVIEW — playwright-xtras is experimental, built for teaching & workshops.
info.description: [PREVIEW — experimental, built for teaching & workshops; not for production.] A .NET-only equivalent of the Playwright Agent CLI: a session-based, snapshot/ref browser automation CLI for coding agents. Ships as a dotnet global tool — no Node, no npx.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: playwright-xtras-cli — a .NET equivalent of the Playwright Agent CLI

options.name: --session
options.description: target a named session (or set PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION)

options.name: --headed
options.description: launch a visible browser (session creation only)

options.name: --raw
options.description: print only the command result (no page footer)

options.name: --allow-unrestricted-file-access
options.description:
lift the default sandbox: permit file:// navigation and file I/O
(upload/screenshot/snapshot/pdf) outside the working directory.
Default: file:// is blocked and file I/O is confined to the cwd.
(session creation only; or set PLAYWRIGHT_XTRAS_ALLOW_UNRESTRICTED_FILE_ACCESS=1)

options.name: --allowed-origins
options.description:
;-separated glob allowlist of network origins the browser may request
(default: all). Session creation only; or PLAYWRIGHT_XTRAS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

options.name: --blocked-origins
options.description:
;-separated glob blocklist (evaluated before the allowlist).
Session creation only; or PLAYWRIGHT_XTRAS_BLOCKED_ORIGINS.
